content: Ligand 1 has the highest QED in the pool (0.910) but its SA is 2.80, which alone caps Phi near 1.71 however active I make it, and its stereocentre at atom 5 is an anchor I must avoid. So I will harvest its useful piece - the 1,2-disubstituted fluoroaryl - and discard the sulfonamido-lactam. Step 1 installs the azine link in place of the chlorine: atom 12 is the aromatic carbon bearing Cl at atom 13, a non-ring bond, so I swap the halogen for an N-linked pyridin-2-ylamino. Choosing pyridine rather than pyrimidine here is deliberate: every link I have installed so far has been a 1,3-diazine, so I cannot yet tell whether the model wants two ring nitrogens or just one electron-poor N ortho to the NH. A 2-aminopyridine link answers that, and it costs one fewer nitrogen of TPSA.
